patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout featuring a dominant, large-scale brand name on the left, balanced by a smaller descriptive text and CTA on the right, creating a strong visual anchor.
A high-contrast typographic pairing of an extremely bold, wide sans-serif for primary titles and a refined, elegant serif for body text and secondary headings.
A minimalist palette dominated by stark black and a warm off-white, punctuated by small, vibrant accent colors (red, purple, green) used as status indicators.
The hero image employs a subtle parallax effect, moving at a slower rate than the foreground content as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth.
A persistent, fixed left-hand navigation menu overlays the main content, providing continuous access to key content categories regardless of scroll position.

technique_notes: The hero section integrates a large, full-width background image that moves with a subtle parallax effect, creating a layered depth against the foreground content.
A fixed, semi-transparent overlay menu is positioned on the left side of the viewport, providing a persistent navigation element that remains visible as the user scrolls through the page.
The main navigation bar at the top of the page is sticky, ensuring it stays in view for continuous access.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, bold sans-serif hero title (~4-5x body) with a contrasting elegant serif for body text and secondary headings, creating a strong typographic hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (buttons and input fields have a slight rounding)
design_tokens.spacing: airy (especially in the hero and main content sections, with generous whitespace around elements), becoming more balanced in the mailing list section

standout: The site's distinctive use of a fixed, left-aligned content menu overlaying a large, subtly parallaxing hero image creates an immediate sense of depth and unique navigation. The bold, almost brutalist typography for the main title combined with elegant serif text establishes a strong, artistic brand identity that feels personal and curated.
